description: Drops a collection and every item in it, permanently. Requires confirm: true; without it nothing is deleted and the call reports what it would have done. Irreversible and not transactional: related items elsewhere may be left orphaned and a RESTRICT foreign key can make the drop fail halfway. Use delete_items to remove rows and keep the collection, delete_field to remove a single field. Take get_schema_snapshot first when the data model may need restoring.
name: delete_collection
